author: Jason Stys
summary: Review nested protected-identity exposure, representative paths, source completeness and owner recertification/expiry queues.
rationale: Keeps complete exposure separate from newly observed drift and avoids false removal claims from partial snapshots.
limitations: SID evidence can be identifying private plaintext; it does not prove effective access or successful revocation.
Exposure reports show one shortest representative path, not every possible nested path.
Absence in partial, unresolved or cyclic evidence is unverified; recertification is not automatically renewed.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
